    A mutable, lazily-materialised façade over Gryphon's purely functional graph types.

    Java façade for minimum spanning tree algorithms on weighted undirected graphs.

    Java façade for strongly-connected-components analysis on directed graphs, using Kosaraju's two-pass algorithm.

    Java façade for topological sorting of directed acyclic graphs (DAGs).
